name: Google Cloud Natural Language
label: Cloud Natural Language API v2
description: Official Cloud Natural Language REST v2 at https://language.googleapis.com. operation: analyze_sentiment (POST /v2/documents:analyzeSentiment), analyze_entities (POST /v2/documents:analyzeEntities), classify (POST /v2/documents:classifyText), moderate_text (POST /v2/documents:moderateText). analyze_syntax is v1-only and is omitted. Auth is Google API key via header x-goog-api-key. Body uses the official Document object. Docs: https://docs.cloud.google.com/natural-language/docs/reference/rest.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Natural Language v2 call. Set operation plus document or type+content (or gcsContentUri). Do not put api_key here. Example: {"operation":"classify","type":"PLAIN_TEXT","content":"The restaurant was excellent."}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: analyze_sentiment | analyze_entities | classify | moderate_text.

schema.label: document
schema.description: Official Document object escape hatch {type, content|gcsContentUri, languageCode}. Merged with type/content/languageCode/gcsContentUri via bodyMap. Example: {"type":"PLAIN_TEXT","content":"Great product."}.

schema.label: encodingType
schema.description: Offset encoding for sentiment/entities. EXACT: NONE | UTF8 | UTF16 | UTF32. Omit to use API default.

schema.label: modelVersion
schema.description: Optional moderate_text modelVersion. EXACT: MODEL_VERSION_UNSPECIFIED | MODEL_VERSION_1 | MODEL_VERSION_2. v2 adds severity for a subset of categories. Omit → API default (v1 confidence only).

schema.label: Document type
schema.description: Document.type for every operation. EXACT: PLAIN_TEXT | HTML. Required by the API when building document from content (not when a full document object is sent). Example: PLAIN_TEXT.

schema.label: Text content
schema.description: Document.content — the text to analyse. Use this or gcsContentUri (not both). Example: The restaurant was excellent. Used by analyze_sentiment, analyze_entities, classify, moderate_text.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Document.languageCode (ISO / BCP-47). Omit to auto-detect. Example: en. Used by all four operations.

schema.label: GCS URI
schema.description: Document.gcsContentUri when the text lives in Cloud Storage. Form: gs://bucket/object. Mutually exclusive with content.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (v2 JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default v2 method. EXACT: analyze_sentiment | analyze_entities | classify | moderate_text. classify = POST /v2/documents:classifyText. moderate_text = POST /v2/documents:moderateText. analyze_syntax is not in v2.

configurationParameters.label: API key
configurationParameters.description: Google Cloud API key with Cloud Natural Language API enabled. Sent as x-goog-api-key. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT. Never logged. OAuth access tokens are not minted by OfficialApiNode.
